observed.pricing_architecture: Replit offers a free entry tier, subscriptions with monthly platform credits, and usage-based spending across Agent and cloud services. Agent execution is effort-priced and may pass through third-party model cost at public API rates.

plans.price_note: Annual price; includes $100 monthly platform credits in captured source.

free_access.note: Starter is listed as a free tier.

expansion_vectors.description: Credits cover both AI Agent and cloud services, increasing account expansion surface.
Higher subscription tiers include larger monthly credit allowances.

analysis.monetization_summary: Replit uses one credit pool to fund AI creation and the deployed application infrastructure it can generate.
